source.original_text: For natural d,q with 2q+1<d, use Ω=(ℝ^d)^(q+1) and its original product standard-Gaussian probability measure μ. Define the inclusive row-truncated Kronecker summands Y_i, their actual means M_i=∫Y_i dμ, Z_i=Y_i−M_i, ρ=2(q+1)(L+1)/d, w_i=cos((2q+1)θ_i), and X_i=ρ⁻¹ w_i Z_i exactly as in the sealed signature. Then for every s>0 and every row i, ∫exp(sX_i) dμ≼exp((exp(s)−s−1)∫X_i² dμ). The case q=0 is retained. All regularity, normalization positivity, centering and spectral-cap facts are internal proof obligations, not additional theorem premises.

decoder_context: Matrix is the finite real square-matrix algebra. Matrix multiplication is ordinary multiplication, scalar multiplication is real scalar multiplication, and 1 is the identity matrix.

For a real square matrix, IsHermitian means that its transpose equals itself. PosSemidef means full positive semidefiniteness, including self-adjointness and nonnegativity of the quadratic form on every real vector; it is not entrywise order.

NormedSpace.exp is the convergent matrix-algebra power-series exponential, not entrywise exponential. Real.exp is the scalar exponential. The matrix norm topology is the real Euclidean operator-norm topology.

Fin n is the finite set of natural numbers less than n, with zero-based i.val. EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) has its Euclidean norm and Borel structure. WithLp.toLp 2 and WithLp.ofLp wrap and unwrap the same coordinates.

stdGaussian is the centered Gaussian probability measure with identity covariance. Measure.pi is the displayed finite product measure on the function space. No conditioning is implicit in a displayed measure or integral.
Real.log is the natural logarithm and Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root. Real inverses are totalized at zero. A cutoff using less-than-or-equal includes equality.
Matrix.vecMulVec u v has entry u_i v_j. The Kronecker product has entry A_(i,k) B_(j,l) at paired row (i,j) and column (k,l), with exactly the displayed factor order.

Integrals are Bochner integrals in the finite matrix space, totalized to zero for nonintegrable functions. Reconstruct the proposition as written without adding integrability premises or conclusions. Each let definition scopes over the full following proposition.
